commands.name: build
commands.description: Runs _phase:build in dependency order; restored from the build cache when inputs are unchanged.

commands.name: typecheck
commands.description: Runs _phase:typecheck after upstream builds; cached by input hash.

commands.name: lint
commands.summary: Lint every project (oxlint), cached by input hash
commands.description: Runs _phase:lint per project; correctness gates as error, suspicious/perf warn.

commands.name: test
commands.summary: Test every project (vitest); builds first, cached by input hash
commands.description: Runs _phase:test after this project and its dependencies are built (the testbed packs the built plugins).

commands.name: publish-check
commands.description: Runs _phase:publish-check after the project builds — publint checks the published shape (exports, files, types), attw checks the type resolution across module modes. Private packages have no such script and are skipped via ignoreMissingScript.

commands.name: format
commands.summary: Format all source with oxfmt (writes in place)
commands.description: Repo-wide formatter (config .oxfmtrc.json). Not a cached per-project phase — it mutates files.

commands.name: format:check
commands.description: Fails if any file is not oxfmt-formatted.
